description: In front of you on the bed are a yellow cup, a gray plastic bin with small clear ice pieces inside, and a purple scoop to the right. The left hand reaches to the yellow cup, grips it as a left-hand object, lifts it over the gray bin, tilts it downward, and dumps ice into the bin before rotating the cup upright and moving it back toward its original spot, while the right hand stays near the purple scoop without picking it up.
